title: scleranthus perennis subsp. marginatus
intro: Scleranthus perennis subsp. marginatus, commonly known as a type of carnation or a plant in the carnation family. It is a perennial herb that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from anxiety, stress, and insomnia due to its calming effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anxiolysis, and relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in Scleranthus perennis subsp. marginatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been found to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
